verdict.rationale: MailerSend's own llms.txt says it can connect directly to AI tools like Claude or Gemini, which is a first-party agent-connection capability. The evidence never names MCP or an official MCP server, and gives no setup or tool details, so the support is thin. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of an official MCP server, documented setup/endpoint or install instructions, list of exposed tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect MailerSend directly to AI tools like Claude or Gemini.
